rationale.energy: Domain-specific median and MAD-derived robust sigma are frozen from the 50k nested training prefix. Twelve robust sigmas quarantines gross MOPAC parser/run failures while retaining broad PM7 tails.
rationale.energy_per_atom_diagnostic: A second, more conservative twenty-sigma check catches gross small-molecule failures hidden by an extensive molecular-energy threshold.
rationale.atomic_charge: A twenty-sigma check catches gross parsed charge corruption; charge-sum conservation remains diagnostic because stored total_charge provenance is not guaranteed for every legacy sample.
rationale.rdkit_failures: RDKit failure does not quarantine the molecule; existing descriptor masks remove only unavailable descriptor supervision.
rationale.recoverability: Every rejected structure is retained in a quarantine ledger with shard, real index, sample key, parent identity, and reason; source LMDBs are never modified.
